upload.title: Check a slip
upload.subtitle: Drop a bank transfer slip. We check it against the bank record — the image is processed in memory and never stored.
upload.dropHere: Drop the slip here, or tap to choose
upload.formats: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF — up to 4 MB
upload.caption: Optional caption
upload.captionPlaceholder: e.g. 590 Aom — expected amount and label
upload.captionHint: Tip: start with the amount to verify it too. Thai and Burmese digits work.
upload.privacy: The slip image is never stored.
upload.tip1: Send the original slip as a file, not a chat-compressed photo.
upload.tip2: Do not crop the QR code.
upload.tip3: Add the expected amount in the caption to catch edited amounts.
upload.failed: The check failed. Please try again.

result.retryScheduled: We will check again automatically and follow up here.
